feedback: Written before this candidate races. The race 10 evidence (entityR2B, 830.86) supports holding this geometry. Oval (20/20) and s-bend (20/20) are both at ceiling, and slalom line loss fell to 0.85 with 9/20 finishes, so the body_length 0.12 m and kd 0.8 changes that drove it are working. Race 9 (entityR2B, 700.30) showed that wheel_track 0.10 m lost slalom finishes (2 to 0) and raised line loss (1.0 to 1.25), so I keep wheel_track 0.12 m. Race 3 (235.88) and race 6 (389.47) showed that the spread and sensor density do not help slalom, so the sensor layout stays. I have kept your geometry exactly and matched the controller to race 10. This is the final iteration, so any mass change would be tested only once, on an untested platform, with no later race to correct it. Mass 0.6 kg therefore stays unexplored here. The outcome of this candidate is not known yet.
